spots.line: The yard is swept. Somebody here still keeps standards.
The causeway is the only way across the moat.

chests.line: An armoury chest in the corner of the yard, unlocked and half empty.
A footlocker nobody has claimed since the last watch changed.

people.name: a watchman off the wall
chatter: Six hours up, six hours down, and the six down are the hard ones.
Rook has the causeway. I have everything he cannot see.

people.name: Vance the Duelist
chatter: The yard is swept because sweeping it is the only order left to give.
Drill at dawn. Two of us. It is still a drill.

people.name: Corvel the Butler
chatter: The hall is aired daily. Nobody comes, but it is aired.
My contract predates the family. They were most surprised too.
